v.why: Adding the direct input-output shortcut where none exists gives large gains (exps 7, 11, 12), unlike replacing an existing conv, pool or 1x1 op on that edge (exps 8-10).
Without the edge-3 shortcut, a skip on edge 0 restores a residual-like path (exp 44: +15 on IN16) instead of just weakening a conv (exp 38).
Skip on edge 4 helps on all three datasets when edge 3 is missing (exp 47) but hurts when the shortcut exists (exp 41).
Skip on edge 5 restores a short path to the output when edge 3 is none (exp 48 positive), whereas with edge 3 present it is mostly harmful (exp 42).
Converting edge 0 to a conv from skip in a conv-free cell yields huge gains (exp 77), far more than replacing a 1x1 conv (exp 83) or none in a conv-rich cell (exp 95).
Replacing parameter-free pooling with a 3x3 conv adds learnable capacity (exps 72, 98), giving more than replacing none or a 1x1 conv (exps 54-57, 84).
When the rest of the cell is pooling, the edge-3 conv is the only parametric path, so its gain is much larger (exps 60, 74) than in conv-rich parents (exps 58, 89).
In skip-dominated cells, adding a conv on the final edge supplies missing capacity (exps 6, 82), unlike conv-heavy parents where it gives mixed results (exps 1-5).
With edge 1 also absent, removing edge 0 cuts the input off from nodes 1 and 2 and collapses the network (exp 17), unlike the mild effects seen otherwise (exps 13-16).
Deleting the identity shortcut from input to output is far more damaging than deleting a conv on that edge (exps 69, 90), consistent with how much adding that skip helps (exps 7, 11, 12).

raw:
I based these on the 98 measurements plus known NAS-Bench-201 structure. Two patterns drive most of them:

- **Adding a conv where the cell has none.** Edits to `nor_conv_3x3` help a lot when the parent cell has no parametric ops (all skip or all avg_pool). They help only modestly when the cell already has convs.
- **The edge 0→3 shortcut.** A skip on edge 3 (input straight to output) matters a lot. Edits that restore a residual-like path are worth far more when edge 3 is `none`. Removing edges that keep the input connected to the output can be catastrophic.
